接口 World

所有超级接口:
net.kyori.adventure.audience.Audience, FeatureFlagSetHolder, net.kyori.adventure.audience.ForwardingAudience, net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, Keyed, Metadatable, PersistentDataHolder, PersistentDataViewHolder, PluginMessageRecipient, net.kyori.adventure.pointer.Pointered, RegionAccessor, WorldInfo
public interface World extends RegionAccessor, WorldInfo, PluginMessageRecipient, Metadatable, PersistentDataHolder, Keyed, net.kyori.adventure.audience.ForwardingAudience
代表一个世界,包含了实体,区块,方块

原文： Represents a world, which may contain entities, chunks and blocks

    • loadChunk

      void loadChunk(@NotNull @NotNull Chunk chunk)
      加载指定的区块.

      本方法将使指定的区块保持加载状态直到卸载方法被手动调用. 建议开发者使用 getChunkAt 方法, 其方法只会临时加载请求的区块, 而不是本方法.

      原文： Loads the specified Chunk.

      This method will keep the specified chunk loaded until one of the unload methods is manually called. Callers are advised to instead use getChunkAt which will only temporarily load the requested chunk.

      参数:
      chunk - 待加载的区块

      原文：The chunk to load

    • isChunkInUse

      @Deprecated(since="1.14") boolean isChunkInUse(int x, int z)
      已过时。
      本方法曾被添加用于促进区块的垃圾回收. 由于当前 Minecraft 的区块被严格管理, 并且除非那些区块正被使用, 否则不会加载超过1tick时长 (意思是mc现在对区块管理更好了, 不用的区块会被及时卸载并回收)

      原文：This method was added to facilitate chunk garbage collection. As of the current Minecraft version chunks are now strictly managed and will not be loaded for more than 1 tick unless they are in use.

      检查指定坐标的区块是否被加载且被一个或更多的玩家使用.

    • loadChunk

      default void loadChunk(int x, int z)
      加载指定坐标的区块.

      本方法将使指定的区块保持加载状态直到卸载方法被手动调用. 建议开发者使用 getChunkAt 方法, 其方法只会临时加载请求的区块, 而不是本方法.

      如果区块不存在则会被生成。

      这个方法类似于当generate值为true时的loadChunk(int, int, boolean).

      原文： Loads the Chunk at the specified coordinates.

      This method will keep the specified chunk loaded until one of the unload methods is manually called. Callers are advised to instead use getChunkAt which will only temporarily load the requested chunk.

      If the chunk does not exist, it will be generated.

      This method is analogous to loadChunk(int, int, boolean) where generate is true.

      参数:
      x - 区块的x坐标

      原文：X-coordinate of the chunk

      z - 区块的z坐标

      原文：Z-coordinate of the chunk

    • addPluginChunkTicket

      boolean addPluginChunkTicket(int x, int z, @NotNull @NotNull Plugin plugin)
      为指定区块添加一个插件票证, 如果该区块尚未加载则会加载它.

      插件票证会阻止区块被卸载, 直到该票证被显式移除. 每个插件实例对每个区块只能持有一张票证, 但每个区块可以拥有多张来自不同插件的票证.

      原文： Adds a plugin ticket for the specified chunk, loading the chunk if it is not already loaded.

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      参数:
      x - 区块的X坐标

      原文：X-coordinate of the chunk

      z - 区块的Z坐标

      原文：Z-coordinate of the chunk

      plugin - 拥有该票证的插件

      原文：Plugin which owns the ticket

      返回:
      true 如果成功添加了插件票证, false 如果该插件已持有该区块的票证

      原文：true if a plugin ticket was added, false if the ticket already exists for the plugin

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalStateException - 如果指定的插件未启用

      原文：If the specified plugin is not enabled

      另请参阅:
      • removePluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)

    • removePluginChunkTicket

      boolean removePluginChunkTicket(int x, int z, @NotNull @NotNull Plugin plugin)
      移除指定插件对指定区块的票证.

      插件票证会阻止区块被卸载, 直到该票证被显式移除. 每个插件实例对每个区块只能持有一张票证, 但每个区块可以拥有多张来自不同插件的票证.

      原文： Removes the specified plugin's ticket for the specified chunk

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      参数:
      x - 区块的X坐标

      原文：X-coordinate of the chunk

      z - 区块的Z坐标

      原文：Z-coordinate of the chunk

      plugin - 拥有该票证的插件

      原文：Plugin which owns the ticket

      返回:
      true 如果成功移除了插件票证, false 如果该区块没有来自该插件的票证

      原文：true if the plugin ticket was removed, false if there is no plugin ticket for the chunk

      另请参阅:
      • addPluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)

    • removePluginChunkTickets

      void removePluginChunkTickets(@NotNull @NotNull Plugin plugin)
      移除指定插件的所有票证.

      插件票证会阻止区块被卸载, 直到该票证被显式移除. 每个插件实例对每个区块只能持有一张票证, 但每个区块可以拥有多张来自不同插件的票证.

      原文： Removes all plugin tickets for the specified plugin

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      参数:
      plugin - 指定的插件

      原文：Specified plugin

      另请参阅:
      • addPluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)
      • removePluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)

    • getPluginChunkTickets

      @NotNull @NotNull java.util.Collection<Plugin> getPluginChunkTickets(int x, int z)
      获取一个集合, 指定哪些插件对指定区块持有票证. 当对该区块添加或移除插件票证时, 该集合不会被更新.

      插件票证会阻止区块被卸载, 直到该票证被显式移除. 每个插件实例对每个区块只能持有一张票证, 但每个区块可以拥有多张来自不同插件的票证.

      原文： Retrieves a collection specifying which plugins have tickets for the specified chunk. This collection is not updated when plugin tickets are added or removed to the chunk.

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      参数:
      x - 区块的X坐标

      原文：X-coordinate of the chunk

      z - 区块的Z坐标

      原文：Z-coordinate of the chunk

      返回:
      不可修改的集合, 包含对该区块持有票证的插件

      原文：unmodifiable collection containing which plugins have tickets for the chunk

      另请参阅:
      • addPluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)
      • removePluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)

    • getPluginChunkTickets

      @NotNull @NotNull java.util.Map<Plugin,java.util.Collection<Chunk>> getPluginChunkTickets()
      返回一个映射, 包含哪些插件对哪些区块持有票证. 返回的映射在添加或移除插件票证时不会被更新. 如果某个插件没有持有任何票证, 则不会出现在映射中.

      插件票证会阻止区块被卸载, 直到该票证被显式移除. 每个插件实例对每个区块只能持有一张票证, 但每个区块可以拥有多张来自不同插件的票证.

      原文： Returns a map of which plugins have tickets for what chunks. The returned map is not updated when plugin tickets are added or removed to chunks. If a plugin has no tickets, it will be absent from the map.

      A plugin ticket will prevent a chunk from unloading until it is explicitly removed. A plugin instance may only have one ticket per chunk, but each chunk can have multiple plugin tickets.

      返回:
      不可修改的映射, 包含哪些插件对哪些区块持有票证

      原文：unmodifiable map containing which plugins have tickets for what chunks

      另请参阅:
      • addPluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)
      • removePluginChunkTicket(int, int, Plugin)

    • findLightningRod

      @Nullable @Nullable Location findLightningRod(@NotNull @NotNull Location location)
      Finds the location of the nearest unobstructed Lightning Rod in a 128-block radius around the given location. Returns null if no Lightning Rod is found.

      Note: To activate a Lightning Rod, the position one block above it must be struck by lightning.

      参数:
      location - Location to search for Lightning Rod around
      返回:
      Location of Lightning Rod or null

    • findLightningTarget

      @Nullable @Nullable Location findLightningTarget(@NotNull @NotNull Location location)
      Finds a target Location for lightning to strike.

      It selects from (in the following order):

      1. the block above the nearest Lightning Rod, found using findLightningRod(Location)
      2. a random LivingEntity that can see the sky in a 6x6 cuboid around input X/Z coordinates. Y ranges from the highest motion-blocking block at the input X/Z - 3 to the height limit + 3

      Returns null if no target is found.

      参数:
      location - Location to search for target around
      返回:
      lightning target or null

      @Deprecated(since="1.13.1") default void getChunkAtAsync(int x, int z, @NotNull @NotNull World.ChunkLoadCallback cb)
      已过时。
      Use either the Future or the Consumer based methods
      Requests a Chunk to be loaded at the given coordinates This method makes no guarantee on how fast the chunk will load, and will return the chunk to the callback at a later time. You should use this method if you need a chunk but do not need it immediately, and you wish to let the server control the speed of chunk loads, keeping performance in mind. The World.ChunkLoadCallback will always be executed synchronously on the main Server Thread.
      参数:
      x - Chunk x-coordinate
      z - Chunk z-coordinate
      cb - Callback to receive the chunk when it is loaded. will be executed synchronously

    • getChunksAtAsync

      void getChunksAtAsync(int minX, int minZ, int maxX, int maxZ, boolean urgent, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.Runnable cb)
      Requests all chunks with x between [minX, maxZ] and z between [minZ, maxZ] to be loaded. This method makes no guarantee on how fast the chunk will load, and will invoke the callback at possibly a later time. You should use this method if you need chunks loaded but do not need them immediately, and you wish to let the server control the speed of chunk loads, keeping performance in mind. The Runnable will always be executed synchronously on the main Server Thread, and when invoked all chunks requested will be loaded.
      参数:
      minX - Minimum Chunk x-coordinate
      minZ - Minimum Chunk z-coordinate
      maxX - Maximum Chunk x-coordinate
      maxZ - Maximum Chunk z-coordinate
      urgent - If true, the chunks may be prioritised to be loaded above other chunks in queue
      cb - Callback to invoke when all chunks are loaded. Will be executed synchronously
      另请参阅:
      • Chunk

    • getNearbyEntities

      @NotNull default @NotNull java.util.Collection<Entity> getNearbyEntities(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, double x, double y, double z)
      返回一个以这个位置为中心的包围着的所有实体的列表(译注:这个可能不太好理解，就是在这个位置，按指定的搜索范围，搜索这个范围里的所有实体).

      这可能不会考虑当前尚未加载的区块中的实体. 一些实现可能会对搜索的范围的大小施加限制.

      原文： Returns a list of entities within a bounding box centered around a Location.

      This may not consider entities in currently unloaded chunks. Some implementations may impose artificial restrictions on the size of the search bounding box.

      参数:
      location - 搜索范围的中心

      原文：The center of the bounding box

      x - 搜索范围的x半轴长度

      原文：1/2 the size of the box along x axis

      y - 搜索范围的y半轴长度

      原文：1/2 the size of the box along y axis

      z - 搜索范围的z半轴长度

      原文：1/2 the size of the box along z axis

      返回:
      在位置附近的实体的集合,一般不为空

      原文：the collection of entities near location. This will always be a non-null collection.

      原文：the maximum distance

      返回:

      原文：the closest ray trace hit result, or null if there is no hit

    • rayTraceBlocks

      @Nullable default @Nullable RayTraceResult rayTraceBlocks(@NotNull @NotNull Location start, @NotNull @NotNull Vector direction, double maxDistance, @NotNull @NotNull FluidCollisionMode fluidCollisionMode, boolean ignorePassableBlocks)
      执行射线跟踪, 使用方块的精确碰撞形状来检查方块碰撞.

      如果忽略与可穿过的方块的碰撞, 则无论流体碰撞模式如何, 也会忽略流体碰撞.

      只有当射线从传送门方块内部开始时, 其才被认为是可穿过的. 除此之外, 即使忽略了与可穿过方块的碰撞, 也将考虑与传送门方块的碰撞.

      这可能会导致区块加载! 一些实现可能会对最大距离施加人为限制.

      原文： Performs a ray trace that checks for block collisions using the blocks' precise collision shapes.

      This may cause loading of chunks! Some implementations may impose artificial restrictions on the maximum distance.

      参数:
      start - 起始位置

      原文：the start location

      direction - 射线方向

      原文：the ray direction

      maxDistance - 最大距离

      原文：the maximum distance

      fluidCollisionMode - 流体碰撞模式

      原文：the fluid collision mode

      ignorePassableBlocks - 是否忽略可穿过但可碰撞的方块(例如高草丛、告示牌、液体等)

      原文：whether to ignore passable but collidable blocks (ex. tall grass, signs, fluids, ..)

      返回:
      最近的射线跟踪命中结果, 如果没有命中, 则为null

      原文：the ray trace hit result, or null if there is no hit

    • rayTraceBlocks

      @Nullable @Nullable RayTraceResult rayTraceBlocks(@NotNull Position start, @NotNull @NotNull Vector direction, double maxDistance, @NotNull @NotNull FluidCollisionMode fluidCollisionMode, boolean ignorePassableBlocks, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.function.Predicate<? super Block> canCollide)
      Performs a ray trace that checks for block collisions using the blocks' precise collision shapes.

      This may cause loading of chunks! Some implementations may impose artificial restrictions on the maximum distance.

      参数:
      start - the start position
      direction - the ray direction
      maxDistance - the maximum distance
      fluidCollisionMode - the fluid collision mode
      ignorePassableBlocks - whether to ignore passable but collidable blocks (ex. tall grass, signs, fluids, ..)
      canCollide - predicate for blocks the ray can potentially collide with, or null to consider all blocks
      返回:
      the ray trace hit result, or null if there is no hit

    • rayTrace

      @Nullable default @Nullable RayTraceResult rayTrace(@NotNull @NotNull Location start, @NotNull @NotNull Vector direction, double maxDistance, @NotNull @NotNull FluidCollisionMode fluidCollisionMode, boolean ignorePassableBlocks, double raySize, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.function.Predicate<? super Entity> filter)
      执行射线跟踪, 检查方块碰撞和实体碰撞.

      方块碰撞使用方块的精确碰撞形状. raySize 参数仅用于实体的碰撞检查.

      如果忽略与可穿过方块的碰撞, 则无论流体碰撞模式如何, 也会忽略流体碰撞.

      只有当射线从传送门方块内部开始时, 其才被认为是可穿过的. 除此之外, 即使忽略了与可穿过方块的碰撞, 也将考虑与传送门方块的碰撞.

      这可能会导致区块加载! 一些实现可能会对最大距离施加人为限制.

      原文： Performs a ray trace that checks for both block and entity collisions.

      Block collisions use the blocks' precise collision shapes. The raySize parameter is only taken into account for entity collision checks.

      This may cause loading of chunks! Some implementations may impose artificial restrictions on the maximum distance.

      参数:
      start - 起始位置

      原文：the start location

      direction - 射线方向

      原文：the ray direction

      maxDistance - 最大距离

      原文：the maximum distance

      fluidCollisionMode - 流体碰撞模式

      原文：the fluid collision mode

      ignorePassableBlocks - 是否忽略可穿过但可碰撞的方块(例如高草丛、告示牌、液体等)

      原文：whether to ignore passable but collidable blocks (ex. tall grass, signs, fluids, ..)

      raySize - 在进行碰撞检查之前, 实体边界框将按此值均匀地放大(或缩小)

      原文：entity bounding boxes will be uniformly expanded (or shrunk) by this value before doing collision checks

      filter - 只考虑满足此过滤器的实体, 或者 null 考虑所有实体

      原文：only entities that fulfill this predicate are considered, or null to consider all entities

      返回:
      最近的方块或实体的射线跟踪命中结果, 如果没有命中, 则为null

      原文：the closest ray trace hit result with either a block or an entity, or null if there is no hit

    • setTime

      void setTime(long time)
      设置服务器的在游戏中的相对时间.

      相对时间类似于小时数*1000（译注：意思是，如果这个世界在游戏中的时间为一个小时则相对时间显示为1000，一小时十二分为1200).

      注意设置的相对时间如果小于当前相对时间则实际上是将时钟向前移动了一天。如果你要倒回时间，请使用setFullTime(long).

      原文： Sets the relative in-game time on the server.

      The relative time is analogous to hours * 1000

      Note that setting the relative time below the current relative time will actually move the clock forward a day. If you require to rewind time, please see setFullTime(long)

      参数:
      time - 设置的在游戏中的新的相对时间（格式为小时数*1000）

      原文：The new relative time to set the in-game time to (in hours*1000)

      另请参阅:
      • Sets the absolute time of this world

      void setClearWeatherDuration(int duration)
      设置晴朗天气的持续时间 (单位为 tick). 晴朗天气的持续时间决定着是否允许世界下雨或打雷. 如果持续时间为 > 0, 那么在持续时间过后, 世界也不会自然地下雨/雪. 本方法等效于 /weather clear 持续时间.

      原文： Set the clear weather duration. The clear weather ticks determine whether or not the world will be allowed to rain or storm. If clear weather ticks are > 0, the world will not naturally do either until the duration has elapsed. This method is equivalent to calling /weather clear with a set amount of ticks.

      参数:
      duration - 持续时间, 单位为 tick

      source - 用于追踪伤害来源的实体

      原文：the source entity, used for tracking damage

      如果爆炸被取消则返回false, 否则返回true

    • spawn

      @NotNull <T extends LivingEntity> T spawn(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.Class<T> clazz, @NotNull CreatureSpawnEvent.SpawnReason spawnReason, boolean randomizeData, @Nullable @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<? super T> function) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      在给定的位置创建一个新实体, 并在实体被添加到世界之前运行提供的函数.
      注意, 当函数运行时, 实体实际上还未进入世界. 在此函数返回之前, 任何涉及该实体的操作(如传送实体)都是未定义的. 但是, 传入的函数在潜在实体的生成随机化之后运行, 因此已经允许访问生物的值, 无论这些值是否被随机化, 例如属性或实体装备.

      原文： Creates a new entity at the given Location with the supplied function run before the entity is added to the world.
      Note that when the function is run, the entity will not be actually in the world. Any operation involving such as teleporting the entity is undefined until after this function returns. The passed function however is run after the potential entity's spawn randomization and hence already allows access to the values of the mob, whether or not those were randomized, such as attributes or the entity equipment.

      类型参数:
      T - 正在创建的实体的泛型类型.

      原文：the generic type of the entity that is being created.

      参数:
      location - 实体将被生成的位置.

      原文：the location at which the entity will be spawned.

      clazz - 要生成的生物实体的类.

      原文：the class of the LivingEntity that is to be spawned.

      spawnReason - 在CreatureSpawnEvent调用期间提供的原因.

      原文：the reason provided during the CreatureSpawnEvent call.

      randomizeData - 实体的数据是否应该在生成前被随机化. 默认情况下, 实体在生成前会对其装备、年龄、属性等进行随机化. 这种随机化的示例包括羊的颜色、生物装备上的随机附魔, 甚至僵尸变成骑鸡僵尸. 如果设置为false, 实体在生成前不会被随机化, 意味着所有数据将保持默认状态, 不会对实体进行进一步修改. 值得注意的是, 只有继承Mob接口的实体才提供生成随机化逻辑. 因此此参数对任何其他类型的实体无用.

      原文：whether or not the entity's data should be randomised before spawning. By default entities are randomised before spawning in regards to their equipment, age, attributes, etc. An example of this randomization would be the color of a sheep, random enchantments on the equipment of mobs or even a zombie becoming a chicken jockey. If set to false, the entity will not be randomised before spawning, meaning all their data will remain in their default state and not further modifications to the entity will be made. Notably only entities that extend the Mob interface provide randomization logic for their spawn. This parameter is hence useless for any other type of entity.

      function - 在实体生成之前运行的函数.

      原文：the function to be run before the entity is spawned.

      返回:
      生成的实体实例.

      原文：the spawned entity instance.

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果world或clazz参数为null.

      原文：if either the world or clazz parameter are null.

    • spawnFallingBlock

      @NotNull @Deprecated(since="1.20.2", forRemoval=true) @NotNull FallingBlock spawnFallingBlock(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, @NotNull @NotNull MaterialData data) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
      Use RegionAccessor.spawn(Location, Class, Consumer) (or a variation thereof) in combination with FallingBlock.setBlockData(BlockData)
      在给定的位置生成一个掉落中的方块实体, 使用指定的MaterialData. MaterialData决定下落的内容. 当下落方块碰到地面时, 它将放置该方块.

      Material必须是方块类型, 可通过data.getItemType().isBlock()检查. Material不能是空气.

      原文： Spawn a FallingBlock entity at the given Location of the specified MaterialData. The MaterialData dictates what is falling. When the FallingBlock hits the ground, it will place that block.

      The Material must be a block type, check with data.getItemType().isBlock(). The Material may not be air.

    • getTicksPerAnimalSpawns

      @Deprecated(since="1.18.1") default long getTicksPerAnimalSpawns()
      已过时。
      建议使用 getTicksPerSpawns(SpawnCategory)

      原文：Deprecated in favor of getTicksPerSpawns(SpawnCategory)

      获取世界生成动物的时间间隔（单位为tick）。

      这个数值决定每次尝试生成动物之间的时间间隔（单位为tick）。

      用法示例：

      • 数值为1意味着服务器每1tick都会尝试在这个世界生成动物。
      • 数值为400意味着服务器每400tick会尝试在这个世界生成动物。
      • 数值低于0则会被重置为Minecraft的默认值。

      注意： 如果设置为0，则会禁止这个世界生成动物。我们一般使用setSpawnFlags(boolean, boolean)来代替。

      Minecraft的默认值：400。

      原文： Gets the world's ticks per animal spawns value

      This value determines how many ticks there are between attempts to spawn animals.

      Example Usage:

      • A value of 1 will mean the server will attempt to spawn animals in this world every tick.
      • A value of 400 will mean the server will attempt to spawn animals in this world every 400th tick.
      • A value below 0 will be reset back to Minecraft's default.

      Note: If set to 0, animal spawning will be disabled for this world. We recommend using setSpawnFlags(boolean, boolean) to control this instead.

      Minecraft default: 400.

      返回:
      世界生成动物的时间间隔（单位为tick）

      原文：The world's ticks per animal spawns value

      这个数值决定每次尝试生成水生环境生物之间的时间间隔（单位为tick）.

      用法示例：

      • 数值为1意味着服务器每1tick都会尝试在这个世界生成水生环境生物.
      • 数值为400意味着服务器每400tick会尝试在这个世界生成水生环境生物.
      • 数值低于0则会被重置为Minecraft的默认值.

      注意： 如果设置为0, 则会禁止这个世界生成水生环境生物.

      Minecraft的默认值：1.

      原文： Sets the world's ticks per water ambient mob spawns value

      This value determines how many ticks there are between attempts to spawn water ambient mobs.

      Example Usage:

      • A value of 1 will mean the server will attempt to spawn water ambient mobs in this world on every tick.
      • A value of 400 will mean the server will attempt to spawn water ambient mobs in this world every 400th tick.
      • A value below 0 will be reset back to Minecraft's default.

      Note: If set to 0, water ambient mobs spawning will be disabled for this world.

      Minecraft default: 1.

      参数:
      ticksPerWaterAmbientSpawns - the ticks per water ambient mob spawns value you want to set the world to

    • playSound

      default void playSound(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String sound, float volume, float pitch)
      在世界中指定的位置播放一个声音.

      如果位置或声音为空则这个函数会失效. 如果客户端没有对应传入值的声音, 玩家将不会听到任何声音.

      原文：The internal sound name to play

      原文：The pitch of the sound

      void playSound(@NotNull @NotNull Location location, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String sound, @NotNull @NotNull SoundCategory category, float volume, float pitch, long seed)
      在世界中指定的位置播放一个声音. 对于有多个变体的声音, 传递相同的种子将始终播放相同的变体.

      如果位置或声音为空则这个函数会失效. 如果客户端没有对应传入值的声音, 玩家将不会听到任何声音.

      原文： Play a Sound at the provided Location in the World. For sounds with multiple variations passing the same seed will always play the same variation.

      This function will fail silently if Location or Sound are null. No sound will be heard by the players if their clients do not have the respective sound for the value passed.

      参数:
      location - 播放声音的位置

      原文：The location to play the sound

      sound - 要播放的内部声音名称

      原文：The internal sound name to play

      category - 声音类别

      原文：the category of the sound

      volume - 声音音量

      原文：The volume of the sound

      pitch - 声音音调

      原文：The pitch of the sound

      seed - 声音种子

      原文：The seed for the sound

    • spawnParticle

      default void spawnParticle(@NotNull @NotNull Particle particle, @NotNull @NotNull Location location, int count, double offsetX, double offsetY, double offsetZ)
      在目标位置生成粒子（由count指定数量）. 每个粒子的位置将根据偏移参数在每个轴上进行正向和负向的随机偏移.

      原文： Spawns the particle (the number of times specified by count) at the target location. The position of each particle will be randomized positively and negatively by the offset parameters on each axis.

      参数:
      particle - 要生成的粒子

      原文：the particle to spawn

      location - 生成粒子的位置

      原文：the location to spawn at

      count - 粒子数量

      原文：the number of particles

      offsetX - X轴上的最大随机偏移量

      原文：the maximum random offset on the X axis

      offsetY - Y轴上的最大随机偏移量

      原文：the maximum random offset on the Y axis

      offsetZ - Z轴上的最大随机偏移量

      原文：the maximum random offset on the Z axis

    • locateNearestStructure

      @Nullable @Deprecated(since="1.19") @Nullable Location locateNearestStructure(@NotNull @NotNull Location origin, @NotNull StructureType structureType, int radius, boolean findUnexplored)
      已过时。
      建议使用 locateNearestStructure(Location, Structure, int, boolean) 或 locateNearestStructure(Location, StructureType, int, boolean)

      原文：Use locateNearestStructure(Location, Structure, int, boolean) or locateNearestStructure(Location, StructureType, int, boolean) instead.

      查找最近的指定结构类型的结构. 查找未探索的结构可能会阻塞, 如果世界正在查看尚未生成的区块. 这可能导致世界在定位未探索的结构时暂时冻结.

      radius不是严格的方形半径. 每种结构可能改变每次迭代检查的区块数量. 不要假设只会检查半径*半径的区块区域. 例如, StructureType.WOODLAND_MANSION可能会检查距离20000个方块（或更多）远的地方, 无论使用的半径是多少.

      此方法不会加载或生成区块. 如果你只查找未探索的结构, 这也可能导致服务器挂起的情况. 这是因为它会不断向外寻找以找到该结构.

      原文： Find the closest nearby structure of a given StructureType. Finding unexplored structures can, and will, block if the world is looking in chunks that have not generated yet. This can lead to the world temporarily freezing while locating an unexplored structure.

      The radius is not a rigid square radius. Each structure may alter how many chunks to check for each iteration. Do not assume that only a radius x radius chunk area will be checked. For example, StructureType.WOODLAND_MANSION can potentially check up to 20,000 blocks away (or more) regardless of the radius used.

      This will not load or generate chunks. This can also lead to instances where the server can hang if you are only looking for unexplored structures. This is because it will keep looking further and further out in order to find the structure.

      参数:
      origin - 开始查找结构的位置

      原文：where to start looking for a structure

      structureType - 要查找的结构类型

      原文：the type of structure to find

      radius - 搜索半径（以区块为单位）

      原文：the radius, in chunks, around which to search

      findUnexplored - 是否只查找未探索的结构

      原文：true to only find unexplored structures

      返回:
      最近的位置, 如果不存在指定类型的结构则返回null

      原文：the closest Location, or null if no structure of the specified type exists.

      另请参阅:
      • locateNearestStructure(Location, Structure, int, boolean)
      • locateNearestStructure(Location, StructureType, int, boolean)

    • locateNearestStructure

      @Nullable @Nullable StructureSearchResult locateNearestStructure(@NotNull @NotNull Location origin, @NotNull @NotNull StructureType structureType, int radius, boolean findUnexplored)
      查找最近的指定结构类型的结构. 查找未探索的结构可能会阻塞, 如果世界正在查看尚未生成的区块. 这可能导致世界在定位未探索的结构时暂时冻结.

      radius不是严格的方形半径. 每种结构可能改变每次迭代检查的区块数量. 不要假设只会检查半径*半径的区块区域. 例如, StructureType.WOODLAND_MANSION可能会检查距离20000个方块（或更多）远的地方, 无论使用的半径是多少.

      此方法不会加载或生成区块. 如果你只查找未探索的结构, 这也可能导致服务器挂起的情况. 这是因为它会不断向外寻找以找到该结构.

      搜索StructureType和Structure的区别在于, StructureType可以引用多个结构, 而搜索Structure只会搜索给定的Structure.

      原文： Find the closest nearby structure of a given StructureType. Finding unexplored structures can, and will, block if the world is looking in chunks that have not generated yet. This can lead to the world temporarily freezing while locating an unexplored structure.

      The radius is not a rigid square radius. Each structure may alter how many chunks to check for each iteration. Do not assume that only a radius x radius chunk area will be checked. For example, StructureType.WOODLAND_MANSION can potentially check up to 20,000 blocks away (or more) regardless of the radius used.

      This will not load or generate chunks. This can also lead to instances where the server can hang if you are only looking for unexplored structures. This is because it will keep looking further and further out in order to find the structure.

      The difference between searching for a StructureType and a Structure is, that a StructureType can refer to multiple Structures while searching for a Structure while only search for the given Structure.

      参数:
      origin - 开始查找结构的位置

      原文：where to start looking for a structure

      structureType - 要查找的结构类型

      原文：the type of structure to find

      radius - 搜索半径（以区块为单位）

      原文：the radius, in chunks, around which to search

      findUnexplored - 是否只查找未探索的结构

      原文：true to only find unexplored structures

      返回:
      最近的位置和结构, 如果不存在指定类型的结构则返回null

      原文：the closest Location and Structure, or null if no structure of the specified type exists.

      另请参阅:
      • locateNearestStructure(Location, Structure, int, boolean)

    • locateNearestBiome

      @Nullable default @Nullable BiomeSearchResult locateNearestBiome(@NotNull @NotNull Location origin, int radius, @NotNull @NotNull Biome... biomes)
      查找最近的与提供的生物群系匹配的位置. 查找生物群系可能会阻塞, 如果世界正在查看尚未生成的区块. 这可能导致世界在定位生物群系时暂时冻结.

      注意：此方法不会反映世界生成后所做的更改, 此方法只能看到世界生成时的生物群系. 此方法不会加载或生成区块.

      如果提供了多个生物群系, BiomeSearchResult.getBiome()将指示定位到的是哪一个.

      此方法将使用32的水平间隔和64的垂直间隔, 等同于/locate命令.

      原文： Find the closest nearby location with a biome matching the provided Biome(s). Finding biomes can, and will, block if the world is looking in chunks that have not generated yet. This can lead to the world temporarily freezing while locating a biome.

      Note: This will not reflect changes made to the world after generation, this method only sees the biome at the time of world generation. This will not load or generate chunks.

      If multiple biomes are provided BiomeSearchResult.getBiome() will indicate which one was located.

      This method will use a horizontal interval of 32 and a vertical interval of 64, equal to the /locate command.

      参数:
      origin - 开始查找生物群系的位置

      原文：where to start looking for a biome

      radius - 搜索半径（以方块为单位）

      原文：the radius, in blocks, around which to search

      biomes - 要搜索的生物群系

      原文：the biomes to search for

      返回:
      包含最近的位置和生物群系的BiomeSearchResult, 如果未找到生物群系则返回null

      原文：a BiomeSearchResult containing the closest Location and Biome, or null if no biome was found.

      另请参阅:
      • locateNearestBiome(Location, int, int, int, Biome...)

    • locateNearestBiome

      @Nullable @Nullable BiomeSearchResult locateNearestBiome(@NotNull @NotNull Location origin, int radius, int horizontalInterval, int verticalInterval, @NotNull @NotNull Biome... biomes)
      查找最近的与提供的生物群系匹配的位置. 查找生物群系可能会阻塞, 如果世界正在查看尚未生成的区块. 这可能导致世界在定位生物群系时暂时冻结.

      注意：此方法不会反映世界生成后所做的更改, 此方法只能看到世界生成时的生物群系. 此方法不会加载或生成区块.

      如果提供了多个生物群系, BiomeSearchResult.getBiome()将指示定位到的是哪一个. 较高的horizontalInterval和verticalInterval值将导致更快的搜索, 但可能会遗漏较小的生物群系.

      原文： Find the closest nearby location with a biome matching the provided Biome(s). Finding biomes can, and will, block if the world is looking in chunks that have not generated yet. This can lead to the world temporarily freezing while locating a biome.

      Note: This will not reflect changes made to the world after generation, this method only sees the biome at the time of world generation. This will not load or generate chunks.

      If multiple biomes are provided BiomeSearchResult.getBiome() will indicate which one was located. Higher values for horizontalInterval and verticalInterval will result in faster searches, but may lead to small biomes being missed.

      参数:
      origin - 开始查找生物群系的位置

      horizontalInterval - 每次检查之间的水平距离

      原文：the horizontal distance between each check

      verticalInterval - 每次检查之间的垂直距离

      原文：the vertical distance between each check

      biomes - 要搜索的生物群系

      原文：the biomes to search for

      返回:
      包含最近的位置和生物群系的BiomeSearchResult, 如果未找到生物群系则返回null

      原文：a BiomeSearchResult containing the closest Location and Biome, or null if no biome was found.

      • locateNearestBiome(Location, int, Biome...)

      获取与给定坐标区块相交的所有指定结构的已生成结构.
      如果不存在结构, 则返回空集合.

      原文： Gets all generated structures of a given Structure that intersect the chunk at the given coordinates.
      If no structures are present an empty collection will be returned.

      参数:
      x - 区块的X坐标

      原文：X-coordinate of the chunk

      z - 区块的Z坐标

      原文：Z-coordinate of the chunk

      structure - 要查找的结构

      原文：the structure to find

      返回:
      给定坐标区块中已放置的结构集合

      原文：a collection of placed structures in the chunk at the given coordinates
